segments.name: Operations/customer success lead at a fast-growing company
segments.organization: Scaling SaaS or service company with a dedicated ops/CS function
segments.workflow: Builds and maintains customer-facing intake forms (support triage, satisfaction surveys, onboarding) that route into team tools, replacing ad hoc spreadsheets or email threads; multiple teammates need to edit and brand these forms under one shared workspace
segments.need: Run structured, branded, team-maintained customer-facing forms/surveys that integrate into existing workflow tools (e.g. Notion, Google Sheets, Make, Zapier) without engineering help
segments.buyer_role: Ops or CS team lead / manager who controls the team's tool budget
segments.user_role: Operations/customer success team members who build and edit forms collaboratively
segments.current_alternative: Spreadsheets, email-based intake, Typeform, or Google Forms with manual routing

reasons: Fetched examples (GLOWDEGA, Handl.me) show a solo skincare-studio owner and a niche community founder using branded client-intake/user-research forms, not the described scaling SaaS/service company with a dedicated multi-person ops/CS function editing shared forms

Pro's collaboration, custom-domain and branding-removal features (tally.so/pricing) technically match the stated need, but no fetched source shows a company with a dedicated ops/CS team and multiple form editors actually running or paying for this workflow at the scale the candidate describes
Re-ranked on matching researched sources (3 fetched).
unknowns: Whether any organization with a dedicated, multi-person ops/CS function and shared form editing actually uses Tally this way, versus the solo/small-team examples that were fetched
Whether the free tier's unlimited forms/submissions already satisfies this audience, removing the stated Pro-upgrade trigger

dossier.orientation: Tally is an online form builder whose forms are written like a document, with shared Pro workspaces for multiple editors, branding controls, and native connections into Notion and Google Sheets.

setup_conditions: Pro plan subscription is required for shared workspaces, team invites, branding removal and custom (sub)domain hosting (R1, R3, R5, E16, E17)
Notion integration requires publishing the form and connecting a Notion account (R6)
Google Sheets integration requires a free Google account (R7)
Free-tier use of unlimited forms and submissions stays within the published fair usage guidelines (E1, E15)
decision_gaps: Does Tally publish native Make and Zapier connectors, and with what documented setup, since only Notion and Google Sheets integrations are in the selected evidence?
Can per-workspace access rights actually restrict what an invited member edits or deletes, given the documentation states all organization users have the same rights?
defining_need_fit.supported_core_workflow: Run structured, branded, team-maintained customer-facing forms/surveys that integrate into existing workflow tools (e.g. Notion, Google Sheets, Make, Zapier) without engineering help
defining_need_fit.caveat: Native Notion property coverage excludes Person and Relation properties, Make and Zapier connectors are not established by the selected evidence, and all organization members hold identical create/edit/delete rights apart from two owner-only privileges.
defining_need_fit.why: No-code form building, shared Pro workspaces with unlimited invited editors, branding removal plus custom-domain links, and native real-time routing into Notion and Google Sheets cover the whole stated task for the example tools named in the need.

ranked_relevance.why: Documents the free native mechanism that sends submissions to Notion databases without Zapier, with its publish/connect setup and its Person/Relation property exception.
Documents the native mechanism that sends submissions to Google Sheets in real time for all users, requiring only a free Google account.
Documents how shared maintenance works: Pro invites an unlimited number of team members to shared workspaces and shares forms and results without exchanging logins.
Pro branding removal is a required capability in this audience definition for customer-facing forms.
Pro custom (sub)domain hosting is the other required capability, giving branded form links.
Describes the Pro workspace/folder structure and per-workspace invitation and access management that keeps multiple teams' forms organized.
States the documented exception to shared maintenance: every organization member has identical create, edit, view and delete rights, with only two owner-exclusive privileges.
Names the price of the Pro plan that gates the branding, custom-domain and shared-workspace capabilities this need requires, at €20 per month on monthly billing.

segment_objections.objection: The need names Make and Zapier, but only Notion and Google Sheets connections are documented in the selected evidence.
segment_objections.answer: Two native, documented routes exist today — a free native Notion integration requiring no Zapier, and a Google Sheets integration that sends submissions in real time with a free Google account — while Make and Zapier support is not established by the selected evidence.

segment_objections.objection: If several teammates maintain production intake forms, can we limit who can edit or delete them?
segment_objections.answer: Pro lets you invite members per workspace and manage access there, but the documentation states all organization users have the same create, edit, view and delete rights, with version history allowing restoration up to 30 days.
